pages.task: Draw the NEW ARCHER in this pose. Image 1 = EXACT character reference: copy face, beard, hair, costume, palette and rendering style identically. Image 2 (old archer) is ONLY a rough body-pose guide, never copy its costume, hood or quiver. Pose: READY stance: relaxed combat stance, weight slightly forward, LEFT arm hanging forward-low at hip height (fist at left side in front, where a bow would be held low), RIGHT arm relaxed near the belt, head up looking at the target. Canvas 584x454, same scale as Image 1, feet at y~448, facing right, real transparent background. Strictly medieval. WITH BOW: paint a simple wooden medieval hunting longbow (string visible) held in the LEFT hand and the arrow (wooden shaft, grey fletching, steel bodkin head); right hand wears the three-finger glove, clearly visible on the string.  The LAST image is the approved bare version of this exact pose: keep body, face, costume and pose identical to it and only ADD the bow and arrow.
